variants.headline: Party leader blunders in election debate
variants.body: The leader of {party}, {leader}, has blundered in an election debate. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.body: An election debate has included a blunder by {leader}, leader of {party}. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.
